description: Unit tests for the CoalescingCertVerifier class in the net namespace, focusing on request coalescing, configuration changes, request deletion safety, and observer forwarding.

classes.name: CoalescingCertVerifierTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing CoalescingCertVerifier behavior.

classes.name: CertVerifierObserverCounter
classes.description: Observer class used to count CertVerifierChanged notifications.

methods.name: SyncCompletion
methods.description: Tests that synchronous completion does not cause issues.

methods.name: InflightJoin
methods.description: Verifies that multiple requests with identical parameters join into a single verification.

methods.name: DoesNotJoinAfterConfigChange
methods.description: Ensures configuration changes prevent request joining.

methods.name: DoesNotJoinAfterUnderlyingVerifierChange
methods.description: Ensures that underlying verifier changes prevent request joining.

methods.name: ObserverIsForwarded
methods.description: Checks that CertVerifierChanged events are forwarded to observers.

methods.name: DeleteSecondRequestDuringFirstCompletion
methods.description: Tests safe deletion of a second request during first request's completion.

methods.name: DeleteVerifierDuringCompletion
methods.description: Tests safe deletion of the verifier during request completion.

methods.name: DeleteRequestBeforeCompletion
methods.description: Tests safe deletion of a request before completion.

methods.name: DeleteFirstRequestBeforeCompletionStillCompletesSecondRequest
methods.description: Ensures second request completes correctly after first is deleted.

methods.name: DeleteRequestDuringCompletion
methods.description: Tests safe deletion of a request during its completion callback.

methods.name: DeleteVerifierBeforeRequest
methods.description: Tests behavior when verifier is deleted before request is issued.
